evidence_class: Actual compiled AVR firmware executing with simulated device protocols, GPIO, ADC, UART and I2C

gh32.contract: Minimum 5000 ms dwell, 20 Hz scan, no early transition; deadline plus100 ms and one measured loop
gh32.fixture: One-time timer0 seed at main entry, followed by normal timer interrupts across unsigned wrap

ordinary_browser_build_run.visible_analog_controls: Soil A0/A1, outside light A2, inside light A3
ordinary_browser_build_run.visible_clock_controls: DS3231 time and reversible frozen/disconnected/none fault controls

scope_limits: Private Lab candidate; public Lab deployment support must be checked separately.
Sensor protocol simulation does not prove physical sensor accuracy or actuator/load-driver safety.
The timer fixture is not 49 days of natural uptime.
Video review, article publication and final links remain in preparation.
